title: Route ALL calls through the gatekeeper (model + search) + no-bypass test — Epic 13
prompt:
Route every external call (Pydantic AI model calls and SearchProvider calls) through ApiGatekeeper. Add a test asserting there is no bypass path.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: Sixth task of Epic 13 (docs/prds/api-gatekeeper.md §2/§6: 'No direct API calls may bypass the gatekeeper'; 'no bypass exists (test-enforced)'). Two external-call kinds: (1) MODEL calls already route through gatekeeper.execute(service='anthropic') via the engine (engine/turn.py + _call.py, tasks 6.3/6.4) — verified as the only model-call path (turn.py passes agent.run_sync BY REFERENCE into execute; no parenthesised invocation anywhere). (2) SEARCH calls were NOT yet routed. TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_search_gatekept.py (5 tests) + packages/core/tests/test_no_bypass.py (5 tests), watched them fail (ImportError: GatekeptSearchProvider), then implemented to green. Routing approach: new GatekeptSearchProvider (packages/core/src/agent_debate/core/search/gatekept.py) — a transparent decorator over any SearchProvider (analogous to ResilientSearchProvider) that, on each search(), routes the inner provider's live call through gatekeeper.execute(self._inner.search, query, max_results=..., service=SEARCH_SERVICE) instead of calling it directly. Factory wiring: create_search_provider(settings, *, gatekeeper=None) now wraps the active provider in GatekeptSearchProvider when a gatekeeper is supplied (backward-compatible default: None -> bare provider, all existing search/registry tests stay green). Added constants.SEARCH_SERVICE='search' (named, mirrors LOOP_MODEL_SERVICE='anthropic'; gatekeeper reads limits from config/rate_limits.json, falls back to 'default' when unconfigured — 0 hard-coded values). Re-exported GatekeptSearchProvider from search/__init__ and core/__init__. mypy: made name a plain settable attribute (self.name=inner.name) not a @property so the structural SearchProvider protocol (settable name) is satisfied when returned as SearchProvider. No-bypass enforcement (test_no_bypass.py) — TWO complementary checks: (a) BEHAVIORAL: a spy gatekeeper asserts the gatekept search provider invokes execute(service='search') on each search (engine model-call routing already proven in test_turn_timeout.py::test_call_routes_through_gatekeeper, referenced); (b) STRUCTURAL/static: a maintainable source grep over packages/*/src (comments + string literals stripped via tokenize, so docstring prose never false-positives) asserts the only direct external-call constructs (DDGS(, .run_sync(, .run_async()) live inside a named _ALLOWLISTED_FILES constant (only duckduckgo.py — the DDGS _fetch seam wrapped by execute); a NEW direct call elsewhere fails the test, catching a future bypass at CI. A guard test asserts the scan globbed real files (no vacuous pass). Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . clean; mypy = no issues in 135 source files; pytest --cov = 513 passed, 100% total coverage (>=85 required); check_line_limit.py rc=0 (all files <=150 code lines); secret_scan.py rc=0. docs/PROMPTS.md entry added.
